description: Canonical registry of every nominator the corpus records: parties, coalitions, electoral committees and self-nomination (issue #82). Bootstrapped 2026-08-30 from the 427 distinct nominator/party-list surface forms measured over all 113,073 records; every measured form is an exact alias of exactly one entry. Matching is exact alias -> punctuation/case-folded alias -> unmatched (reported, never guessed) -- scraper/shared/parties.py. Renames stay one entry (the old name is an alias); mergers get a new entry with the merged organisations as predecessors. Coalitions carry their member party ids as `nariai` only where the coalition's own name enumerates them or the line-up is unambiguous; an absent `nariai` means not recovered, never empty. A line naming a party plus 'issikele pats' is the party's alias: the line names it. `unmatched` is the escape hatch for future scrapes -- a form that matches no entry lands there via scripts/nominator_report.py, and tests/test_party_registry.py asserts it is empty.
